data.summary: Transition Management professional with 7+ years of experience leading global service migrations from US and UK to India delivery centers within financial services. Experienced in managing the end-to-end transition lifecycle including transition planning, knowledge transfer (KT), ramp-up strategy, governance, and risk management. Proven ability to align global stakeholders, implement structured transition frameworks, and ensure seamless handover into steady-state operations with minimal disruption. Strong communicator and trusted partner to senior leadership, onsite SMEs, and global delivery teams, driving transition success through structured governance, risk management, and continuous process improvement.
